summary: Chapter III is one of four scattered parts of Master Nesingwary’s manuscript, The Green Hills of Stranglethorn. Barnil is gathering the pages at the camp in Stranglethorn Vale.

sections.title: Scattered Pages
sections.body: A gust swept through Master Nesingwary’s camp in Stranglethorn Vale and scattered the manuscript pages through the jungle. Barnil gathered most of them, but the four chapters remain incomplete. He is collecting the pages so the manuscript can be put back in order.

faq.answer: Chapter III is one of the four parts of Master Nesingwary’s scattered manuscript, The Green Hills of Stranglethorn.
Barnil is gathering the scattered pages and organizing the chapters for Master Nesingwary.
A large gust of wind blew through Master Nesingwary’s camp and scattered the manuscript pages across the jungle.
The manuscript is called The Green Hills of Stranglethorn.
